$schema_note: THETA internal research archetypes -- how Claude organizes expert-evidence and hypotheses for study. These are NOT the frozen runtime 'strategy_branch' enum (THETA_CONVENTIONAL / THETA_HOLD_STRIKE / THETA_DEFINED_RISK / THETA_RECOVERY / THETA_CC, defined in the Backend Schema section 7 and implemented in the SQL bootstrap). Where an archetype maps closely to one runtime branch that is stated explicitly below; where it is cross-cutting (applies across branches, e.g. management/roll logic) that is stated too. Do not treat this file as redefining the schema enum -- it organizes research, the schema enum drives runtime behavior.

archetypes.name: Quality Ownership
archetypes.description: Underlying/CSP-entry selection hypotheses: is this underlying acceptable to own under the put strike, independent of which runtime branch eventually opens the position. Covers ownership_acceptability, severe-drawdown probability, and the explicit rejection of premium-blind or IV-rank-blind entry.
archetypes.branch_relationship: cross-cutting: every runtime branch's entry step depends on the ownership-quality judgment this archetype studies (TRD UNIV-001..003, section 43 Underlying Ownership model), it is not itself a branch.
primary_trd_sections: section 0.2 (high IV alone is not sufficient)

archetypes.name: Hold-the-Strike
archetypes.description: Short-dated (2-5 DTE) ATM/near-ATM assignment-aware entry policy on separately validated underlying/policy cohorts, with intentional assignment and a recovery-wait step before considering a covered call.
archetypes.branch_relationship: direct match: this archetype is the research programme behind the THETA_HOLD_STRIKE runtime branch (TRD section 15) -- a research challenger, not the default, per the TRD's own framing.

archetypes.name: Roll Intelligence
archetypes.description: Management-timing hypotheses: when (if ever) closing or rolling a short option before expiration beats holding to expiration or full-cycle resolution, and the requirement that any roll beat the best feasible alternative computed at the same decision timestamp, never applied as a universal early/late rule.
archetypes.branch_relationship: cross-cutting: management/roll decisions (TRD section 22, section 24) apply inside any branch's open position, not to one branch alone.

archetypes.name: Covered-Call Monetization
archetypes.description: Once stock is held (via assignment or otherwise), how to select and manage covered calls: trading off premium, retained upside, call-away regret, and event risk rather than maximizing annualized yield alone; explicitly excludes selling a call immediately after every assignment as a default.
archetypes.branch_relationship: direct match: this archetype is the research programme behind the THETA_CC runtime branch.

archetypes.name: Assignment/Recovery
archetypes.description: What happens after assignment: whether assignment itself is an acceptable outcome given ownership quality, how long recovery-wait should run before a bounded exit, and -- critically -- how assignment-heavy performance must be reported (Managed Episode WR, Whole-Chain WR, Open MTM together) so headline win rate never hides unresolved inventory drawdown.
archetypes.branch_relationship: direct match for the recovery-wait management state; also draws on the full CSP-to-stock lineage that section 4's lifecycle diagram treats as one chain, not a separate branch.

archetypes.name: Defined-Risk Challenger (later)
archetypes.description: Put-credit-spread or other defined-risk alternative when full cash-secured CSP quantity would be zero or tail risk is better bounded as a spread. Explicitly deferred: TRD section 3.1 permits this only after Level 3 options support and separate OOS validation; it is registered here for research completeness, not for near-term work.
archetypes.branch_relationship: direct match: this archetype is the research programme behind the (explicitly optional, later) THETA_DEFINED_RISK runtime branch.
archetypes.gated_until: Alpaca options trading Level 3 confirmed on the account (see docs/DATA_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.md, OPTIONS_TRADING_LEVEL) AND THETA-Q/H/R/C/A have graduated per docs/PHASED_PLAN.md. Do not begin implementation work on this archetype before both conditions are met.

cross_cutting_failure_dna.statement: A high closed-trade or Leg win rate never proves an archetype is safe on its own. Every archetype's performance must be reported as Leg WR, Managed Episode WR, Whole-Chain WR, and Open MTM together (TRD OUT-001..004) -- this is a standing constraint on how ALL archetypes are evaluated, not a property of any single one, which is why it is recorded here rather than folded into just THETA-A.
